result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with no stock. The full suite passes offline (607 tests, 0 failures).

**Change:** In `listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 1489), the query now adds `AND s.quantity > 0`, the same filter the category and slow-moving overviews use. `StockService.getWarehouseStock` delegates to this method, so it covers the stock list. I left `findStockQuantity` alone, so asking for the quantity of an empty product still returns 0.

I did not add a test for the example in the task (the bolt/nut/screw case). Nothing was committed.
